data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'rain', meaning 'rain' or 'precipitation'. This name is often given to girls born during the rainy season, or to those whose parents wish to bestow upon them the blessings of the rain. The name Raaina carries the meaning “Rain” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Raaina usually hope their child will grow to embody rain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
